title: Los Angeles Sites and Celebrity Homes Private Flexible Day Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Includes pickup and drop-off at your hotel. This tour is a flexible tour. Remaining hours are for travel between sites as well as desired stops for photo opportunities.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
LA's iconic sites PLUS celebrity homes in one tour! Wouldn’t it be nice to not be tied down to a rigid schedule and cramped in with dozens of other tourists? In the hands of a state-certified, professional, and personable driver, you will be transported in a private and comfortable SUV for your small group of up to 6 passengers to visit all of the iconic sites of Los Angeles like Hollywood, Beverly Hills, Santa Monica, Venice & more. Your driver will be knowledgeable in the locations for the best photo opportunities and even show you extra sites usually not covered by other tours. This tour has a flexible schedule. You can opt in or out of any of the stops. Hotel pickup and drop-off included. (Order of stops depends on pickup location). Short stay in LA? Ask about our 1/2 day. 

You can also try our Beach Towns Tour!
